author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
description: Battle paradigm configurations for Tenebris and Lux

modes.name: Traditional Turn-Based
modes.description: Classic JRPG command-driven battle system with initiative order, resource pools, and deterministic relic resonance attrition.

modes.name: Tactical Grid-Based (TRPG)
modes.description: Isometric/orthogonal grid strategy battles featuring movement budgets (MP), facing, flanking bonuses, tile hazards, and zone of control.

modes.name: Cinematic Action Skirmish
modes.description: Real-time action combat resolution featuring active kinetic deflection windows with Shield of Lux and poise severance strings with Sword of Tenebris.
